[ALERT] Instrumented Cron Job Non-Zero Exit Detection fired

Use case: UC-1.1.10 — Instrumented Cron Job Non-Zero Exit Detection

Severity tier: medium (investigative)

Investigate context and correlate with recent changes before escalation.

Detects each unique, instrumented cron run whose wrapper recorded a numeric child `exit_code` other than zero during the search window. Each result is identified by host and `run_id` and includes the stable job label, completion time, duration, owner, and wrapper version; one valid non-zero completion event is sufficient to create a row.
